notes: This materializes deterministic public coefficient, incidence, and diagonal seeds for each row.
The generated tilt has exactly three nonzero row entries per tilt column and is combined with Cauchy guard/base blocks over the row's prime field.

Compressed view rows now report route diagnostics: support-covered rows need a concrete hitting-set certificate, while lossy-budget rows report whether the viewed-noise and viewed-separation checks are already satisfied.

A guard-block lossy view is a strong candidate when the selected prefix contains the full guard block and the lossy noise/separation budget passes; non-full views still require proof-carrying evidence before acceptance.
Passing rows should still be treated as candidates for deeper bounded dual-witness search and estimator work, not as deployed parameters.
